errors.nothingToSave: There is nothing waiting to be saved.
errors.noPageToFill: There is no page to fill.
errors.offForSite: This extension is switched off for this site.
errors.notForSite: That item is not saved for this site.
errors.noLoginForm: No login form was found on this page.
errors.whichPolaris: Say which Polaris this is first.
errors.serverSilentSignIn: That server did not answer. Sign in again.
errors.unreachable: That server could not be reached.
errors.sessionEnded: That session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.itemMissing: That item is not here. Sync and try again.
errors.noItemKey: This vault does not hold the key for that item.
errors.changedElsewhere: Somebody changed this item elsewhere. It has been refreshed; try again.
errors.notAnAddress: That does not look like an address.
errors.noPermission: Without permission for that address, nothing can be read from it.
errors.serverTooOld: That server did not answer. It may be older than this extension.
errors.connectFirst: Connect this browser to Polaris first.
errors.lostRequest: This browser lost the request. Ask again.
errors.cannotOpenReply: What came back could not be opened. Ask again.
errors.vaultWithoutAccount: That approval carried the vault but not your account. Update Polaris from Settings, and if it refuses again, check your account is still allowed to use the vault.
errors.notSignedInHere: That account is not signed in here.
errors.signOutFirst: Sign out of this account first.
errors.notInOrg: You are not part of that organization.
errors.nothingBack: Nothing came back from that server.
errors.noCode: That item has no one-time code.
errors.badAuthenticator: That authenticator value cannot be read.
errors.noCodeWaiting: There is no code waiting for this page.
errors.nothingWaiting: There is nothing waiting for this page.
errors.noSiteToSwitch: There is no site here to switch off.
errors.noInline: This browser cannot show Polaris inside a page.
errors.silentWorker: Polaris did not answer. Open this again.

menu.fill: Fill the login for this site

save.nameIt: Give it a name so you can find it again.
save.webPage: The address has to be a web page.
save.nothingYet: Add a username or a password: there is nothing to save yet.

unlock.noKeys: This browser is no longer holding your vault keys. Ask Polaris to let it in again.
unlock.noDerivation: This copy of the extension could not run your vault's key derivation. Updating it is what fixes that.
unlock.wrongPassword: That password did not open the vault.

generator.nothing: Nothing can be made of that.
generator.oneStaysOn: At least one kind has to stay on
generator.avoidHint: Leave out 0 and O, 1, l and I
generator.useHint: Put it straight into a new login
